A trapezoidal channel having bottom width 7 m and side slopes 3 horizontal to 2 15   
vertical is laid on a bottom slope of 1 in 2000. If it carries a uniform flow of water at   
the rate of 9.5 m3/s, determine - (i) the normal depth, (ii) the mean velocity of flow.   
Take Manning's n as 0.03.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year Special Backlog Examination, 2021
